defmodule EmailService.CircuitBreaker do
  use GenServer

  @failure_threshold 5
  @reset_timeout 30_000

  defstruct state: :closed, failure_count: 0, last_failure: nil

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %__MODULE__{}, opts)
  end

  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  def call(pid, fun) do
    GenServer.call(pid, {:execute, fun})
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, fun}, _from, %{state: :open, last_failure: last} = state) do
    if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - last > @reset_timeout do
      execute_with_breaker(fun, %{state | state: :half_open})
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :circuit_open}, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:execute, fun}, _from, state) do
    execute_with_breaker(fun, state)
  end

  defp execute_with_breaker(fun, state) do
    case fun.() do
      {:ok, result} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, result}, %{state | state: :closed, failure_count: 0}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        new_count = state.failure_count + 1
        new_state = if new_count >= @failure_threshold do
          %{state | state: :open, failure_count: new_count, last_failure: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}
        else
          %{state | failure_count: new_count}
        end
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, new_state}
    end
  end
end

defmodule EmailService.AttachmentStore do
  @moduledoc "Handles attachment storage with content-type validation"

  @upload_dir "/var/lib/email_service/attachments"
  @max_file_size 10_485_760

  # MIME types allowed for email attachments
  @allowed_content_types ~w(
    application/pdf
    image/png
    image/jpeg
    image/gif
    text/plain
    text/csv
    application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet
    application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document
  )

  def store_attachment(%{filename: filename, content_type: content_type, data: data}) do
    with :ok <- validate_file_size(data),
         :ok <- validate_content_type(content_type),
         safe_name <- sanitize_filename(filename),
         :ok <- validate_extension_matches_type(safe_name, content_type),
         :ok <- validate_magic_bytes(data, content_type) do
      dest_path = Path.join(@upload_dir, safe_name)
      File.write(dest_path, data)
      {:ok, %{path: dest_path, filename: safe_name, content_type: content_type}}
    end
  end

  defp validate_file_size(data) when byte_size(data) <= @max_file_size, do: :ok
  defp validate_file_size(_), do: {:error, :file_too_large}

  defp validate_content_type(ct) do
    # Normalize content type by extracting base type before parameters
    base_type = ct |> String.split(";") |> List.first() |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
    if base_type in @allowed_content_types, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_content_type}
  end

  defp sanitize_filename(filename) do
    filename
    |> Path.basename()
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, "_")
    |> then(fn name ->
      case name do
        "." <> _ -> "attachment" <> name
        _ -> name
      end
    end)
  end

  defp validate_extension_matches_type(filename, content_type) do
    ext = Path.extname(filename) |> String.downcase()
    base_type = content_type |> String.split(";") |> List.first() |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
    expected_exts = extension_map()[base_type] || []
    if ext in expected_exts, do: :ok, else: {:error, :extension_mismatch}
  end

  defp validate_magic_bytes(data, content_type) do
    base_type = content_type |> String.split(";") |> List.first() |> String.trim() |> String.downcase()
    case base_type do
      "application/pdf" ->
        if String.starts_with?(data, "%PDF"), do: :ok, else: {:error, :magic_bytes_mismatch}
      "image/png" ->
        if :binary.part(data, 0, min(byte_size(data), 8)) == <<137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10>>,
          do: :ok, else: {:error, :magic_bytes_mismatch}
      "image/jpeg" ->
        if :binary.part(data, 0, min(byte_size(data), 2)) == <<255, 216>>,
          do: :ok, else: {:error, :magic_bytes_mismatch}
      "image/gif" ->
        header = :binary.part(data, 0, min(byte_size(data), 6))
        if header == "GIF87a" or header == "GIF89a",
          do: :ok, else: {:error, :magic_bytes_mismatch}
      _ -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp extension_map do
    %{
      "application/pdf" => [".pdf"],
      "image/png" => [".png"],
      "image/jpeg" => [".jpg", ".jpeg"],
      "image/gif" => [".gif"],
      "text/plain" => [".txt", ".log", ".md"],
      "text/csv" => [".csv"],
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet" => [".xlsx"],
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" => [".docx"]
    }
  end
end

defmodule EmailService.Mailer do
  @moduledoc "Email sending service with circuit breaker and attachment support"

  @breaker_name EmailService.Breaker

  def send_email(%{to: to, subject: subject, body: body} = params) do
    attachments = Map.get(params, :attachments, [])

    with {:ok, stored_attachments} <- process_attachments(attachments) do
      EmailService.CircuitBreaker.call(@breaker_name, fn ->
        do_send(to, subject, body, stored_attachments)
      end)
    end
  end

  defp process_attachments(attachments) do
    results = Enum.map(attachments, &EmailService.AttachmentStore.store_attachment/1)
    errors = Enum.filter(results, &match?({:error, _}, &1))

    if errors == [] do
      {:ok, Enum.map(results, fn {:ok, att} -> att end)}
    else
      {:error, {:attachment_errors, errors}}
    end
  end

  defp do_send(to, subject, body, attachments) do
    # Simulate SMTP send with attachments
    email = %{
      to: to,
      subject: subject,
      body: body,
      attachments: Enum.map(attachments, fn att ->
        %{filename: att.filename, path: att.path, content_type: att.content_type}
      end)
    }

    case EmailService.SMTPClient.deliver(email) do
      :ok -> {:ok, :sent}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end
end
